---
title: "TAOOH — primary model fitting"
subtitle: "Second-order Bayesian ordinal transition models with random intercepts"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

The primary model conditions on `yprev` and `ypprev` and includes the
patient-level random intercept specified in the SAP. One model is saved per
completed dataset.

```{r}
#| label: fit-taooh-models
#| include: false

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "markov-helpers.R"))
library(rmsb)

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$main$m)[1:20]
taooh_diagnostic_thresholds <- config$diagnostics
# A small number of divergences is retained for review rather than causing an
# automatic full refit. Twenty or more divergences still trigger the retry.
taooh_diagnostic_thresholds$max_divergent_transitions <- 19L
data_dir <- here::here("artifacts", "primary", "taooh", "imputations")
model_dir <- here::here("artifacts", "primary", "taooh", "models")
diagnostic_dir <- here::here("artifacts", "primary", "taooh", "diagnostics")
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(diagnostic_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (index in indices) {
  data_path <- file.path(data_dir, sprintf("imputation-%02d.parquet", index))
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  diagnostic_path <- file.path(
    diagnostic_dir,
    sprintf("diagnostics-%02d.parquet", index)
  )
  if (!force && file.exists(model_path) && file.exists(diagnostic_path)) next

  data <- arrow::read_parquet(data_path) |>
    as.data.frame() |> 
    dplyr::mutate(ecog_fstcnt = factor(ecog_fstcnt, ordered = FALSE))
  # The imputation branches contain only participants with at least one
  # observed weekly TAOOH outcome.

  dd <- rms::datadist(data)
  options(datadist = "dd")
  model_formula <- y ~ tx + rms::rcs(week, 4) + yprev + ypprev +
    week %ia% yprev + week %ia% ypprev +
    ecog_fstcnt + diagnosis + rms::rcs(albumin, 3) +
    rms::rcs(c_reactive_protein, 3) + cluster(id)
  fit_seed <- analysis_seed(config, "taooh", index)

  fit <- tryCatch(
    markov.misc::blrm_markov(
      formula = model_formula,
      ppo = ~week,
      cppo = function(y) as.numeric(as.character(y)),
      data = data,
      id_var = "id",
      time_var = "week",
      chains = config$markov$chains,
      iter = config$markov$iterations,
      warmup = config$markov$warmup,
      refresh = 1,
      backend = "cmdstan",
      loo = FALSE,
      sampling.args = list(
        seed = fit_seed,
        parallel_chains = config$markov$chains
      )
    ),
    error = identity
  )

  diagnostics <- if (inherits(fit, "error")) NULL else
    tryCatch(
      markov_diagnostics(fit, taooh_diagnostic_thresholds),
      error = function(error) NULL
    )

  if (is.null(diagnostics) || !isTRUE(diagnostics$passed)) {
    fit <- markov.misc::blrm_markov(
      formula = model_formula,
      data = data,
      id_var = "id",
      time_var = "week",
      chains = config$markov$chains,
      iter = config$markov$retry_iterations,
      warmup = config$markov$retry_iterations / 2L,
      refresh = 0L,
      backend = "cmdstan",
      loo = FALSE,
      sampling.args = list(
        seed = fit_seed + 500000L,
        parallel_chains = config$markov$chains
      )
    )
    diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(fit, taooh_diagnostic_thresholds)
  }

  assert_markov_diagnostics(diagnostics)
  saveRDS(fit, model_path, compress = "xz")
  diagnostic_output <- as.data.frame(diagnostics$summary)
  diagnostic_output$imputation <- index
  diagnostic_output$divergent_transitions <- diagnostics$divergent_transitions
  diagnostic_output$treedepth_exceeded <- diagnostics$treedepth_exceeded
  diagnostic_output$min_bfmi <- diagnostics$min_bfmi
  arrow::write_parquet(diagnostic_output, diagnostic_path)
}
```
